create_Pets_dataset_train: create a Pets VisionDataset instance for training by loading trainval.txt annotations from the Oxford Pets dataset root directory
create_Pets_dataset_test: create a Pets VisionDataset instance for testing by loading test.txt annotations from the Oxford Pets dataset root directory
getitem_Pets_image_target: get an RGB image and its zero-indexed label from the Pets dataset by index using the __getitem__ method
len_Pets_dataset: get the total number of images in the Pets dataset by calling len on the Pets instance
review_Pets_class: review the Pets class that extends VisionDataset to load and serve Oxford Pets images with optional transforms
